tools.name: scout_quote
tools.description: Price one specific request without running it: no search, no inference, nothing spent. Returns items[] (one line per source plus the answer fee), total_flop (Scout's fee), charged_flop (null while metering is nominal) and quota. With q and a flop: model it also returns inference.floor and inference.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "scout_answer" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
